subject: Azure Marketplace listing — SKU pricing, identity mapping & co-sell opt-in
messages:
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>
To: Contoso - Marketplace PM <contoso-pm@contoso.com>, Microsoft Marketplace Team <marketplace@microsoft.com>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 11 Aug 2026 14:02:00 -0700
Subject: Azure Marketplace listing — SKU pricing, identity mapping & co-sell opt-in

Hi everyone,

Thanks for the earlier sync, wanted to capture the immediate asks so we can move the offer into the publisher portal next week. We're preparing a multi-SKU SaaS listing for Contoso (standard/pro/enterprise) and want to opt into the Azure co-sell program. Attached are two working docs: a SKU/pricing matrix and a draft identity mapping file that ties Contoso tenant IDs to the publisher artefacts.

Can you confirm the following?
- What exact identity proof (company docs/MPN) Microsoft needs for publisher account verification for co-sell opt-in.
- Any required format for the identity mapping JSON or a preferred field we should include (e.g., partnerCenterId, tenant_friendly_name).
- Pricing guidance: does Marketplace require MSRP + plan-level prices, or is a single public price sufficient for co-sell?
- Expected SLA/timeline for technical validation once we upload the offer (Contoso is pushing to have listing live by Aug 20).

I'm looping in Soojin and Karthik for technical and commercial sign-off. Contoso PM, please share any additional constraints from your procurement side (tax IDs, invoice address).

Attachments: azure_offer_sku_matrix.xlsx (xlsx), identity_mapping_v2.json (json)

Thanks,

Hannah Schmitt

Subject: Re: Azure Marketplace listing — SKU pricing, identity mapping & co-sell opt-in

Thanks Hannah — good capture. A few quick notes from the product/offer side: 

1) SKU packaging and pricing
- Recommend publishing three explicit plans (Standard / Pro / Enterprise) as separate plans under one offer (single GUID). Azure likes clear plan-level pricing for catalog visibility. Include both monthly and annual list prices in the matrix.
- For co-sell, ensure the public listing contains a representative price; transaction-level pricing can be handled via Private Plans or marketplace-managed pricing if Contoso needs custom terms.

2) Identity and publisher proof
- From our previous publisher setups: Microsoft requires MPN + legal entity documents (incorporation) and a contact with Partner Center access.
- For SaaS offers we need an Azure AD app registration or redirect URI for verification if there are single-sign flows.
- For the identity_mapping_v2.json we should add fields: "partnerCenterId", "publisherTenantId", "marketplaceContactEmail". I'll attach a small template in Drive.

3) Co-sell opt-in steps
- Opt-in is done in Partner Center; Microsoft usually asks for a co-sell program form and Partner Center ID. Validation is typically 3 business days if all docs are in order.

Next steps I suggest:
- Hannah: confirm Contoso procurement contact and invoice/tax details.
- Marissa: can you review the SKU matrix and validate pricing tiers (I marked two items with pricing flags)?
- Karthik: once we have identity mapping template finalized, please prepare the portal payload for upload.

From: Microsoft Marketplace Team <marketplace@microsoft.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 12 Aug 2026 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Azure Marketplace listing — SKU pricing, identity mapping & co-sell opt-in

Hi Hannah,

Thanks for the details and attachments. Quick guidance from the Marketplace side:

- Required artifacts for publisher verification: MPN ID, signed incorporation certificate (PDF), proof of address, and Partner Center contact with admin rights. For co-sell opt-in specifically we also ask for the Partner Center account to be linked to your MPN.
- Identity mapping: the JSON template you used is fine; please include "partnerCenterId" and "publisherTenantId" fields. For SaaS offers include the AAD app redirect URI where applicable.
- Pricing: Marketplace prefers explicit plan-level prices. For co-sell eligibility we need a public/list price for the plan. If Contoso needs custom discounts, use Private Plans linked to the public plan.
- Technical validation SLA: once the offer is submitted with all artifacts, validation is typically 2-4 business days. Any missing doc will reset the timer.

Next steps we need from you to progress:
1) Upload the offer draft into Partner Center and attach MPN + incorporation doc.
2) Confirm the Partner Center contact email (so we can trigger validation).
3) If you want us to review the SKU matrix before submission, send a one-page summary and we can do a pre-check (48-hour turnaround).

I've copied our partner onboarding specialist who can accept the pre-check. If you want to opt into co-sell immediately, please confirm the Partner Center ID in reply.

Regards,
Marketplace Onboarding Team
Microsoft Corporation
marketplace@microsoft.com

--
Attachment stub: marketplace_validation_checklist.pdf (pdf)
